title: FTC Funeral Rule, General Price List checks
scope: General Price List only. Casket Price List, Outer Burial Container Price List and the Statement of Funeral Goods and Services Selected are out of scope for this version.
status: draft, not legal advice; see README.md risk summary

source.ecfr_note: eCFR versions API lists no substantive amendment to Part 453 after its 2016-12-22 baseline (2023-04-10 entries are non-substantive).
source.ftc_guide: Complying with the Funeral Rule, FTC publication 565A, 2025 edition

verdicts.pass: Requirement met, or met by a lawful variant.
verdicts.fail: Deterministic check against Rule text found the requirement unmet. Only checks with basis "rule" and engine "deterministic" may emit fail.
verdicts.review: A person should look. Used for placement, adequacy, intent, state-dependent variants and anything inferred by a model. Never phrased as a violation.
verdicts.not_applicable: The condition that triggers the requirement is absent (for example, no direct cremation offered).

basis_values.rule: Requirement stated in 16 CFR 453 text; the check cites the paragraph.
basis_values.guide: Interpretation from the FTC compliance guide, not Rule text.
basis_values.heuristic: Itemized's own judgment call; no legal requirement behind it.

policy.downgrade: Any fail whose evidence comes from an extraction field marked low-confidence, or from a page the extractor could not read, is emitted as review with reason "extraction_uncertain".
policy.redacted_elements: When an input's manifest lists an element as redacted (name, address, phone, ...), presence checks for that element return pass with note "redacted_in_corpus".
policy.offered_inference: An item counts as offered only when the GPL itself names it (priced or not), or a package on the GPL includes it. Absence of an item is never a fail.

segment_kinds.optional: May be present or absent; either is a match. Presence or absence is reported as variant_used.
segment_kinds.conditional: Must appear when its `when` condition holds; must be absent otherwise only if `forbidden_otherwise` is true.
segment_kinds.slot: Provider-specific text (dollar amount, container list). Matches any span up to max_chars; an unfilled template marker like "(specify containers)" counts as empty.

thresholds.note: Token-level similarity scored per fixed segment, never over the fixed segments joined: a present conditional sentence sits between them and drags a joined score down (FTC Sample 1 scored 0.70 joined while matching exactly per segment). A disclosure's score is its lowest segment score. >= match: present. Between altered and match: altered (review; could be OCR noise or paraphrase). Below altered or not found: absent. Provisional; tune on Day 3 against the synthetic set.

conditions.basic_services_priced: GPL shows a separate price for basic services of funeral director and staff.
conditions.basic_services_declared_nondeclinable: The right-of-selection disclosure contains its conditional sentence, or the basic-services disclosure D-basic-nondeclinable is present. Either is the provider's own statement that the fee cannot be declined.
conditions.caskets_as_range: GPL shows a casket price range rather than individual casket prices.
conditions.obc_as_range: GPL shows an outer burial container price range.
conditions.obc_itemized: GPL shows individual outer burial container prices.

D-selection.title: Right to select only the items you want

segments.t: The goods and services shown below are those we can provide to our customers. You may choose only the items you desire.
However, any funeral arrangements you select will include a charge for our basic services

If legal or other requirements mean you must buy any items you did not specifically ask for, we will explain the reason in writing on the statement we provide describing the funeral goods and services you selected.

D-basic-nondeclinable.title: Basic services fee will be added

segments.t: This fee for our basic services
will be added to the total cost of the funeral arrangements you select. (This fee is already included in our charges for direct cremations, immediate burials, and forwarding or receiving remains.)

D-embalming.title: Embalming is usually not required by law

segments.omission_note: Lawful only where state or local law never requires embalming; see check C-033.

segments.t: embalming is not required by law. Embalming may be necessary, however, if you select certain funeral arrangements, such as a funeral with viewing. If you do not want embalming, you usually have the right to choose an arrangement that does not require you to pay for it, such as direct cremation or immediate burial.

If you want to arrange a direct cremation, you can use an alternative container. Alternative containers encase the body and can be made of materials like fiberboard or composition materials (with or without an outside covering). The containers we provide are
A complete price list will be provided at the funeral home.

D-obc-list.title: Complete outer burial container price list available

segments.t: A complete price list will be provided at the funeral home.

D-obc-list.note: Same sentence as D-casket-list. When both ranges are shown, the matcher needs two occurrences, one near each range.

D-obc-legal.title: Outer burial containers are usually not required by law

segments.t: In most areas of the country,
segments.omission_note: Lawful only where state or local law never requires a container around the casket; see check C-074.

segments.t: state or local law does not require that you buy a container to surround the casket in the grave. However, many cemeteries require that you have such a container so that the grave will not sink in. Either a grave liner or a burial vault will satisfy these requirements.

D-obc-legal.note: When OBC prices are shown only as a range with D-obc-list, this disclosure belongs on the separate OBC price list instead (453.3(c)(2)) and is out of scope here.

checks.title: Caption "General Price List"
checks.test: caption normalizes to contain "general price list"
checks.plain: The list must be labeled "General Price List" so families know which document it is.

checks.title: Provider name
checks.test: providerName present
checks.plain: The list must name the funeral home.

checks.title: Provider address
checks.test: address present
checks.plain: The list must give the funeral home's address.

checks.title: Provider telephone
checks.test: phone present
checks.plain: The list must give the funeral home's phone number.

checks.title: Effective date present
checks.test: effectiveDate raw text present; an unfilled template marker such as "[date]" counts as absent
checks.plain: The list must say when its prices took effect.

checks.title: Effective date readable
checks.test: effectiveDate parses to a calendar date
checks.plain: A date is printed but we couldn't read it as a date.

checks.title: Effective date may be stale
checks.test: effectiveDate older than 12 months before the audit date
checks.plain: The prices are more than a year old. The Rule doesn't set an expiry, but the Rule does require accurate prices, so ask whether these are still current.

checks.title: Right-of-selection disclosure present
checks.test: D-selection matches (altered => review)
checks.plain: The list must tell you that you can choose only the items you want.

checks.title: Right-of-selection disclosure placed above prices
checks.test: disclosure appears immediately above the itemized prices
checks.plain: The choice statement should come right before the prices.

checks.title: Basic services fee lists the services it covers
checks.test: basic_services item has non-empty includesText
checks.plain: A basic services fee must come with a list of what it pays for.

checks.title: Basic services fee list is adequate
checks.test: includesText names principal services (arrangements conference, permits, notices, shelter of remains, coordination with third parties)
checks.plain: The list of what the basic fee covers looks thin.

checks.title: Non-declinable basic services disclosure present
checks.test: D-basic-nondeclinable matches
checks.plain: This list says its basic fee can't be declined, so it must also say the fee is added to every arrangement and already included in the minimal services.

checks.title: Selection disclosure sentence matches fee status
checks.test: review if D-basic-nondeclinable is present but the D-selection conditional sentence is absent, or if neither is present (the reverse case is C-022)
checks.plain: We can't tell whether the basic services fee can be declined; the two statements that answer that disagree or are both missing.

checks.title: Basic services fee folded into casket prices
checks.test: D-basic-in-casket matches
checks.plain: No separate basic services fee is shown. If it's built into casket prices, the list must say how much.

checks.title: Second non-declinable fee
checks.test: model finds another mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead (e.g., "basic facilities fee", "casket handling fee", "additional services of staff")
checks.plain: The basic services fee is the only fee a funeral home may make mandatory. This list seems to have another.

checks.title: Embalming disclosure present
checks.test: D-embalming matches (altered => review)
checks.plain: Next to the embalming price, the list must say that embalming usually isn't required by law.

checks.title: Embalming disclosure next to embalming price
checks.test: disclosure in immediate conjunction with the embalming price (same page, adjacent block)
checks.plain: The embalming statement should sit right next to the embalming price.

checks.title: Embalming represented as required
checks.test: model finds text saying embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket funeral without viewing
checks.plain: The list seems to say embalming is required where the Rule says a provider may not claim that.

checks.title: Embalming disclosure omits "Except in certain special cases"
checks.test: review when the optional phrase is absent
checks.plain: Leaving out "except in certain special cases" is allowed only where state law never requires embalming. Worth checking for this state.

checks.title: Direct cremation: price with purchaser's container
checks.test: a priced direct cremation option where the purchaser provides the container
checks.plain: The list must price a direct cremation where you bring your own container.

checks.title: Direct cremation: priced option with alternative container
checks.test: at least one priced direct cremation option including an alternative container, or a direct cremation price plus a separately priced container the family can add (decision 2026-10-20; see README)
checks.plain: The list must offer and price a direct cremation with a simple alternative container, not only with a casket.

checks.title: Direct cremation: description of services
checks.test: direct_cremation item has non-empty includesText
checks.plain: The list must say what the direct cremation price includes.

checks.title: Direct cremation: price range shown
checks.test: explicit range present and equal to [min, max] of the options
checks.plain: The list should show the low-to-high range for direct cremation, matching its options.

checks.title: Alternative-container disclosure present
checks.test: D-alt-container matches with a filled containers slot (altered => review)
checks.plain: The list must tell you that you can use an alternative container for direct cremation, and say which ones the funeral home provides.

checks.title: Alternative-container disclosure next to direct cremation
checks.test: disclosure in immediate conjunction with the direct cremation range
checks.plain: The alternative-container statement should sit right next to the direct cremation prices.

checks.title: Casket represented as required for cremation
checks.test: model finds text saying a casket is required for direct cremation
checks.plain: The list seems to say a casket is needed for cremation. A provider may not require or claim that.

checks.title: "And cremation" wording versus crematory cash advance
checks.test: if the description includes the cremation itself, the crematory fee is not also billed as a cash advance, and vice versa
checks.plain: It's unclear whether the crematory's own charge is inside the direct cremation price or added later.

checks.title: Immediate burial: price with purchaser's casket
checks.test: a priced immediate burial option where the purchaser provides the casket
checks.plain: The list must price an immediate burial where you bring your own casket.

checks.title: Immediate burial: priced option with casket or alternative container
checks.test: at least one priced immediate burial option including a casket or alternative container, or a reference to the casket price list
checks.plain: The list doesn't show an immediate burial price that includes a container.

checks.title: Immediate burial: description of services
checks.test: immediate_burial item has non-empty includesText
checks.plain: The list must say what the immediate burial price includes.

checks.title: Immediate burial: price range shown
checks.test: explicit range present and equal to [min, max] of the options
checks.plain: The list should show the low-to-high range for immediate burial, matching its options.

checks.title: Forwarding: list of services
checks.test: forwarding item has non-empty includesText
checks.plain: The forwarding price must come with a list of what it includes.

checks.title: Receiving: list of services
checks.test: receiving item has non-empty includesText
checks.plain: The receiving price must come with a list of what it includes.

checks.title: Every offered required item has a price
checks.test: price or unit price present (for caskets, outer burial containers, direct cremation and immediate burial, a price range with numbers at both ends also counts); "call for pricing", blank or template marker counts as missing
checks.plain: Each listed service must show what it costs.

checks.title: Vague price on a required item
checks.test: price text contains "starting at", "from", "as low as" or similar, outside the casket, OBC, direct cremation and immediate burial ranges the Rule permits
checks.plain: This price is shown as a starting point, so the actual cost isn't clear.

checks.title: Casket prices disclosed
checks.test: caskets_itemized, or caskets_as_range with D-casket-list matched
checks.plain: If caskets are offered, the list must show their prices, or a price range plus a note that a full casket price list is available.

checks.title: Outer burial container prices disclosed
checks.applies_when: outer burial containers named on the GPL
checks.test: obc_itemized with D-obc-legal matched, or obc_as_range with D-obc-list matched
checks.plain: If vaults or grave liners are offered, the list must show prices or a range, plus the statements that go with them.

checks.title: OBC disclosure omits "In most areas of the country"
checks.test: review when the optional phrase is absent
checks.plain: Leaving out "in most areas of the country" is allowed only where state law never requires a grave container. Worth checking for this state.

checks.title: Required items possibly offered but not listed
checks.test: model finds evidence an item is offered (in a package, a description or a policy) without its own itemized price; also flag missing forwarding, receiving, direct cremation or immediate burial, which the FTC guide's tip sheet treats as expected. It looks for goods or services mentioned only inside a package, a description or a policy, and for the four items named above. A line item with its own line on the list, priced or not, is not a concern for this check; other checks cover unpriced lines. Under the Rule's option C(2) the basic services fee may be built into casket prices instead of priced on its own line; that is not a concern for this check.
checks.plain: Something seems to be offered without its own price on the list.

checks.title: Packages without itemized equivalents
checks.test: each package component also appears as an itemized price. A package is an optional combination of goods and services sold at one price. Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are required items whose single price covers several services; they are not packages.
checks.plain: Packages are allowed only in addition to itemized prices, not in place of them.

checks.title: Claims that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase
checks.test: model finds text asserting a purchase is required by law, a cemetery or a crematory
checks.plain: The list says something is required. That claim has to be true, and it's worth checking.

checks.title: Preservation or protection claims
checks.test: model finds claims that goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances
checks.plain: The list seems to claim a product preserves or protects the body. The Rule restricts those claims.

checks.title: Text that alters or contradicts a required disclosure
checks.test: model finds statements that alter or contradict a required disclosure, or required disclosures that are not clear and conspicuous. It looks for other text on the list that undercuts a required disclosure, or a disclosure printed so it is hard to notice. A required disclosure that is missing, reworded or left with an unfilled template blank is reported by other checks; that alone is not a concern for this check.
checks.plain: Other wording on the list may undercut one of the required statements.
